# Vendored test asset: axe-core 4.10.2

`axe.min.js` is the unmodified minified build of [axe-core](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core)
version 4.10.2 (Mozilla Public License 2.0), fetched from
`https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/axe-core/4.10.2/axe.min.js`.

It is vendored so the accessibility gate can run fully offline (air-gapped CI)
without adding a runtime dependency to the application. The license header is
preserved in the file. axe-core is a test-only dependency and is never shipped
to the browser bundle.
